```text
545	def load_project(name):
546	    """Short: cases/<case>/ (+ images/<case>, audio/<case>). Long: a folder with project.json
547	    (lines.json, meta.json, shots.json, scene_prompts.json, images/, audio/, output/ inside it)."""
548	    pdir = ROOT / name
549	    if (pdir / "project.json").exists():
550	        proj = json.loads((pdir / "project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
551	        pid = proj.get("name", pdir.name)
552	        covers = {c: s["id"] for s in json.loads((pdir / "scene_prompts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["scenes"]
553	                  for c in s.get("covers", [s["id"]])}
554	        img_dir = pdir / "images"
555	        return {"kind": "long", "name": pid, "dir": pdir, "burn": proj.get("burn_captions", False),
556	                "image_for": lambda sc: img_dir / f"scene_{covers[sc]:02d}.png",
557	                "audio_dir": pdir / "audio", "cache_dir": ROOT / "cache" / pid, "out_dir": pdir / "output"}
558	    cdir = ROOT / "cases" / name
559	    return {"kind": "short", "name": name, "dir": cdir, "burn": True,
560	            "image_for": lambda sc: ROOT / "images" / name / f"scene_{sc:02d}.png",

565	def main():
566	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
567	    ap.add_argument("case_pos", nargs="?", metavar="case")
568	    ap.add_argument("--case", dest="case_opt", help="same as the positional case name")
569	    g = ap.add_mutually_exclusive_group()

571	    g.add_argument("--final", action="store_true", help="1080x1920 upload build + checks")
572	    ap.add_argument("--spend", action="store_true", help="allow paid TTS for uncached lines")
573	    a = ap.parse_args()
574	    mode = "final" if a.final else "preview"
575	    t_start = time.perf_counter()

577	    name = a.case_opt or a.case_pos
578	    if not name:
579	        ap.error("case/project required: a Shorts case name or a long-video folder (e.g. long-videos/long_01)")
580	    P = load_project(name)
```

```bash
.venv/Scripts/python.exe -X utf8 -c "
import re
t=open('long-videos/long_01/output/long_01.srt',encoding='utf-8').read().strip().split('\n\n')
def s(x):h,m,r=x.split(':');a,b=r.split(',');return int(h)*3600+int(m)*60+int(a)+int(b)/1000
for i,c in enumerate(t):
  L=c.split('\n');a,b=L[1].split(' --> ')
  d=s(b)-s(a)

"
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""YouTube uploader for Story-Channel, used by the Munshi agent.

Usage:
    python tools/youtube_upload.py --job long-videos/long_01/output/upload.json --dry-run
    python tools/youtube_upload.py --job long-videos/long_01/output/upload.json
    python tools/youtube_upload.py --job ... --extras-only   # retry thumbnail/captions/playlist

Safety: refuses to upload unless the logged-in channel ID matches job["channel_id"],
and unless ffprobe confirms the file is a real final build (size, codec, pix_fmt).
One token per channel: secrets/youtube_token_<channel_key>.json.

One-time setup: see the youtube-publish skill. Needs
    pip install google-api-python-client google-auth-oauthlib
and secrets/client_secret.json (OAuth "Desktop app" client).
"""
import argparse
import datetime as dt
import json
import random
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
except Exception:
    pass

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SECRETS = ROOT / "secrets"
CLIENT_SECRET = SECRETS / "client_secret.json"
FORMATS = {  # what a final upload must look like
    "long": {"width": 1920, "height": 1080, "max_seconds": None},
    "short": {"width": 1080, "height": 1920, "max_seconds": 60},
}
SCOPES = [
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload",
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.force-ssl",  # captions + playlists
]
RETRY_STATUS = {500, 502, 503, 504}
MAX_RETRIES = 8


def resolve(job_path: Path, p):
    if not p:
        return None
    p = Path(p)
    return p if p.is_absolute() else (job_path.parent / p).resolve()


def token_path(job):
    return SECRETS / f"youtube_token_{job['channel_key']}.json"


def probe(video: Path):
    """Return (width, height, codec, pix_fmt, seconds) using ffprobe."""
    import shutil
    import subprocess

    if not shutil.which("ffprobe"):
        raise RuntimeError("ffprobe not found (install FFmpeg)")
    out = subprocess.run(
        ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0",
         "-show_entries", "stream=width,height,codec_name,pix_fmt",
         "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "json", str(video)],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    d = json.loads(out)
    st = (d.get("streams") or [{}])[0]
    return (st.get("width"), st.get("height"), st.get("codec_name"),
            st.get("pix_fmt"), float(d.get("format", {}).get("duration", 0)))


def validate(job: dict, job_path: Path) -> list:
    errs = []
    key = job.get("channel_key", "")
    if not key or not all(c.isalnum() or c in "-_" for c in key):
        errs.append("channel_key missing/invalid (e.g. dadi-ki-kahaniyan)")
    cid = job.get("channel_id", "")
    if not (isinstance(cid, str) and cid.startswith("UC") and len(cid) == 24):
        errs.append("channel_id missing/invalid (24 chars, starts with UC; set it in munshi/channel_config.json)")
    fmt = job.get("format")
    if fmt not in FORMATS:
        errs.append("format must be 'long' or 'short'")
    title = job.get("title", "")
    desc = job.get("description", "")
    tags = job.get("tags", [])
    if not title:
        errs.append("title missing")
    if len(title) > 100:
        errs.append(f"title too long ({len(title)} > 100)")
    if len(desc) > 5000:
        errs.append(f"description too long ({len(desc)} > 5000)")
    for name, val in (("title", title), ("description", desc)):
        if "<" in val or ">" in val:
            errs.append(f"{name} contains < or >")
    if sum(len(t) for t in tags) + max(len(tags) - 1, 0) > 500:
        errs.append("tags exceed 500 characters")
    hashtags = [w for w in desc.split() if w.startswith("#")]
    if len(hashtags) > 15:
        errs.append(f"{len(hashtags)} hashtags in description (>15: YouTube ignores all)")
    if not isinstance(job.get("made_for_kids"), bool):
        errs.append("made_for_kids must be true/false (set it in munshi/channel_config.json)")

    video = resolve(job_path, job.get("video"))
    if not video or not video.exists():
        errs.append(f"video not found: {video}")
    else:
        if "preview" in video.name.lower():
            errs.append("video looks like a preview build; upload final only")
        if fmt in FORMATS:
            try:
                w, h, codec, pix, secs = probe(video)
                want = FORMATS[fmt]
                if (w, h) != (want["width"], want["height"]):
                    errs.append(f"video is {w}x{h}, a final {fmt} must be {want['width']}x{want['height']}")
                if codec != "h264":
                    errs.append(f"video codec is {codec}, expected h264")
                if pix != "yuv420p":
                    errs.append(f"pixel format is {pix}, expected yuv420p")
                if secs < 5:
                    errs.append(f"video is only {secs:.1f}s long")
                if want["max_seconds"] and secs > want["max_seconds"]:
                    errs.append(f"short is {secs:.1f}s, max {want['max_seconds']}s")
                job["_probe"] = f"{w}x{h} {codec} {pix} {secs:.1f}s"
            except Exception as e:
                errs.append(f"ffprobe failed: {e}")

    thumb = resolve(job_path, job.get("thumbnail"))
    if thumb:
        if not thumb.exists():
            errs.append(f"thumbnail not found: {thumb}")
        elif thumb.stat().st_size > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
            errs.append("thumbnail larger than 2 MB")
        elif thumb.suffix.lower() not in (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png"):
            errs.append("thumbnail must be .jpg or .png")

    srt = resolve(job_path, job.get("captions"))
    if srt and not srt.exists():
        errs.append(f"captions not found: {srt}")

    pub = job.get("publish_at")
    if pub:
        try:
            t = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(pub)
            if t.tzinfo is None:
                errs.append("publish_at needs a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-21T19:00:00+05:30")
            elif t <= dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) + dt.timedelta(minutes=15):
                errs.append("publish_at must be at least 15 minutes in the future")
        except ValueError:
            errs.append("publish_at is not ISO 8601")
    if job.get("privacy", "private") not in ("private", "unlisted", "public"):
        errs.append("privacy must be private, unlisted or public")
    return errs


def get_service(job):
    from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
    from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials
    from google_auth_oauthlib.flow import InstalledAppFlow
    from googleapiclient.discovery import build

    tok = token_path(job)
    creds = None
    if tok.exists():
        creds = Credentials.from_authorized_user_file(str(tok), SCOPES)
    if not creds or not creds.valid:
        if creds and creds.expired and creds.refresh_token:
            creds.refresh(Request())
        else:
            if not CLIENT_SECRET.exists():
                sys.exit(f"Missing {CLIENT_SECRET}. Do the one-time setup first.")
            print(f"Browser login: pick the Google account AND the channel '{job.get('channel_name', job['channel_key'])}'.")
            flow = InstalledAppFlow.from_client_secrets_file(str(CLIENT_SECRET), SCOPES)
            creds = flow.run_local_server(port=0)
        SECRETS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        tok.write_text(creds.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
    return build("youtube", "v3", credentials=creds)


def check_channel(yt, job):
    """Stop unless the logged-in channel is exactly the configured one."""
    items = yt.channels().list(part="id,snippet", mine=True).execute().get("items", [])
    if not items:
        sys.exit("Logged-in Google account has no YouTube channel. Nothing uploaded.")
    got = items[0]["id"]
    title = items[0]["snippet"]["title"]
    if got != job["channel_id"]:
        sys.exit(f"WRONG CHANNEL: logged in as '{title}' ({got}), expected {job['channel_id']}. "
                 f"Nothing uploaded. Delete {token_path(job).name} in secrets/ and log in again with the right channel.")
    print(f"Channel OK: {title} ({got})")


def with_retry(fn, label):
    from googleapiclient.errors import HttpError

    for attempt in range(MAX_RETRIES + 1):
        try:
            return fn()
        except HttpError as e:
            if e.resp.status not in RETRY_STATUS or attempt == MAX_RETRIES:
                raise
        except (ConnectionError, OSError, TimeoutError):
            if attempt == MAX_RETRIES:
                raise
        wait = min(2 ** attempt + random.random(), 60)
        print(f"{label}: retry {attempt + 1} in {wait:.0f}s")
        time.sleep(wait)


def upload_video(yt, job, job_path):
    from googleapiclient.http import MediaFileUpload

    status = {
        "privacyStatus": job.get("privacy", "private"),
        "selfDeclaredMadeForKids": job["made_for_kids"],
    }
    if "contains_synthetic_media" in job:
        status["containsSyntheticMedia"] = bool(job["contains_synthetic_media"])
    if job.get("publish_at"):
        status["privacyStatus"] = "private"  # required by YouTube for scheduling
        status["publishAt"] = job["publish_at"]

    body = {
        "snippet": {
            "title": job["title"],
            "description": job.get("description", ""),
            "tags": job.get("tags", []),
            "categoryId": str(job.get("category_id", "1")),
            "defaultLanguage": job.get("language", "hi"),
            "defaultAudioLanguage": job.get("language", "hi"),
        },
        "status": status,
    }
    media = MediaFileUpload(str(resolve(job_path, job["video"])), mimetype="video/mp4",
                            chunksize=8 * 1024 * 1024, resumable=True)
    req = yt.videos().insert(part="snippet,status", body=body, media_body=media)
    response = None
    while response is None:
        st, response = with_retry(req.next_chunk, "upload")
        if st:
            print(f"upload {int(st.progress() * 100)}%")
    return response["id"]


def do_extras(yt, job, job_path, video_id, result):
    from googleapiclient.http import MediaFileUpload

    thumb = resolve(job_path, job.get("thumbnail"))
    if thumb and not result.get("thumbnail_ok"):
        try:
            mt = "image/png" if thumb.suffix.lower() == ".png" else "image/jpeg"
            with_retry(lambda: yt.thumbnails().set(
                videoId=video_id, media_body=MediaFileUpload(str(thumb), mimetype=mt)).execute(),
                "thumbnail")
            result["thumbnail_ok"] = True
        except Exception as e:  # usually: channel not phone-verified
            result["thumbnail_error"] = str(e)[:300]

    srt = resolve(job_path, job.get("captions"))
    if srt and not result.get("captions_ok"):
        try:
            lang = job.get("language", "hi")
            with_retry(lambda: yt.captions().insert(
                part="snippet",
                body={"snippet": {"videoId": video_id, "language": lang,
                                  "name": job.get("captions_name", "Hindi"), "isDraft": False}},
                media_body=MediaFileUpload(str(srt), mimetype="application/octet-stream"),
            ).execute(), "captions")
            result["captions_ok"] = True
        except Exception as e:
            result["captions_error"] = str(e)[:300]

    pl = job.get("playlist_id")
    if pl and not result.get("playlist_ok"):
        try:
            with_retry(lambda: yt.playlistItems().insert(
                part="snippet",
                body={"snippet": {"playlistId": pl,
                                  "resourceId": {"kind": "youtube#video", "videoId": video_id}}},
            ).execute(), "playlist")
            result["playlist_ok"] = True
        except Exception as e:
            result["playlist_error"] = str(e)[:300]


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--job", required=True, help="path to upload.json")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="validate only, no network")
    ap.add_argument("--extras-only", action="store_true",
                    help="retry thumbnail/captions/playlist for an already uploaded video")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    job_path = Path(args.job).resolve()
    job = json.loads(job_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    result_path = job_path.parent / "upload_result.json"
    result = json.loads(result_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if result_path.exists() else {}

    errs = validate(job, job_path)
    print("Channel:     ", job.get("channel_name") or job.get("channel_key"), job.get("channel_id"))
    print("Title:       ", job.get("title"))
    print("Video:       ", resolve(job_path, job.get("video")))
    print("Privacy:     ", "scheduled" if job.get("publish_at") else job.get("privacy", "private"))
    print("Publish at:  ", job.get("publish_at") or "-")
    print("Made for kids:", job.get("made_for_kids"))
    print("Thumbnail:   ", job.get("thumbnail") or "-")
    print("Captions:    ", job.get("captions") or "-")
    print("Playlist:    ", job.get("playlist_id") or "-")
    print("Video check: ", job.get("_probe", "-"))
    if errs:
        print("\nPROBLEMS:")
        for e in errs:
            print(" -", e)
        sys.exit(1)
    if args.dry_run:
        print("\nDry run OK. Nothing uploaded.")
        return

    if result.get("video_id") and not args.extras_only:
        sys.exit(f"Already uploaded as {result['video_id']}. Use --extras-only to retry extras.")
    if args.extras_only and not result.get("video_id"):
        sys.exit("No video_id in upload_result.json; nothing to retry.")

    yt = get_service(job)
    check_channel(yt, job)
    if not result.get("video_id"):
        vid = upload_video(yt, job, job_path)
        result.update({
            "video_id": vid,
            "url": f"https://youtu.be/{vid}",
            "studio_url": f"https://studio.youtube.com/video/{vid}/edit",
            "uploaded_at": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "publish_at": job.get("publish_at"),
        })
        result_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print("Uploaded:", result["url"])

    do_extras(yt, job, job_path, result["video_id"], result)
    result_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

Upload ke dono safety checks lag gaye hain aur bina login wala test paas hua. Ek kami hai: is PC par asli upload abhi ruk jayega, kyunki `ffprobe` PATH par nahi hai (neeche dekhiye).

**1. `tools/youtube_upload.py`:** prompt ke content se bilkul waisa hi replace kiya. Ab script upload se pehle ye check karti hai:
- Kis channel se login hai. `channel_id` na mile toh ruk jaati hai aur kuch upload nahi hota.
- Har channel ka token alag file me rehta hai.
- ffprobe se video ka asli size, codec, pix_fmt aur lambai.

**2. `munshi/channel_config.json`:** `"channel_id": ""` aur `"channel_key": "dadi-ki-kahaniyan"` jod diye.

**3. youtube-publish skill:**
- Token ka naya naam `youtube_token_<channel_key>.json` likha.
- Login ke waqt sahi account aur sahi channel dono chunne ki baat jodi.
- Step 4 me `channel_key`, `channel_name`, `channel_id` aur `format` jode.
- WRONG CHANNEL wali line jodi: aisa ho toh ruk kar aapko batana hai, `channel_id` kabhi nahi badalna.

**4. Test:** `py_compile` paas hua. Preview ko `tmp_test.mp4` naam dekar dry-run chalaya. Naam se "preview" hata dene par bhi script ne use pakad liya:
```
Video check:  960x540 h264 yuvj420p 306.2s
PROBLEMS:
 - video is 960x540, a final long must be 1920x1080
 - pixel format is yuvj420p, expected yuv420p
```
Dono temp files aur `upload_safety_prompt.md` (Downloads me thi) ab `_to_delete/` me hain.

**5. Sync:** `pushed: upload: channel-id + ffprobe checks`. Is sync me Long 01 ke chal rahe fixes ke code/json badlav bhi chale gaye: `make_short.py`, `lines.json`, `meta.json`, bible, RULES aur naya thumbnail. Video files nahi gayi.

## ⚠️ Is PC par ek kami
Ye script `ffprobe` ko PATH par dhoondhti hai. Is PC par ye sirf `tools\ffmpeg\` me hai, isliye bina PATH jode test me "ffprobe not found" aaya, aur asli upload bhi isi wajah se ruk jayega. Naye system par `deploy.ps1` FFmpeg ko PATH par install karta hai, toh wahan dikkat nahi hogi.

Is PC ke liye aasaan ilaaj: `D:\Story-Channel\tools\ffmpeg` ko user PATH me jod doon. Isme ₹0 lagega aur script nahi badlegi. Kahein toh kar doon.

## Aapse chahiye
**Channel ID:** YouTube Studio → Settings → Channel → Advanced settings se copy karke bhejiye. Ye UC se shuru hota hai aur 24 characters ka hota hai.

Long 01 ka final build abhi background me chal raha hai. Khatam hote hi Munshi se review karwa kar verdict dikhaunga.

```text
1	# Munshi RULES — Story-Channel
2	
3	These are the hard rules. If a builder summary, a script or a file disagrees with them, the rule wins and the step is not PASS. Edit this file to add new rules; Munshi reads it fresh every time.
4	- A measured value outside a RULES limit is always FIX, never PASS, even if small.
5	
6	## 1. Budget
7	- Prepaid Google Cloud budget: ₹500, auto-reload off. Current balance is whatever `cost_log.csv` says.
8	- Every paid call (Gemini image ≈ ₹3.24 each at 1K, Gemini TTS per line) must be in `cost_log.csv` with date, project, item, ₹.
9	- No paid call without the user's OK first. A fix that costs money is always ASK, never FIX.
10	- Flag it if a step cost more than 30% above its estimate (e.g. LONG_01 TTS: estimate ₹4.85, actual ₹6.63).
11	
12	## 2. Story and characters (from `channel_bible.md`)
13	- Characters must match their approved sheets: face, clothes, colours, age look. Compare each scene image against the sheet with Read.
14	- Dadi (Kamla Devi) narrates. Every other character speaks their own lines in their own voice.
15	- Mitthu (parrot) has no hands: no hand gestures, holding things or pointing with hands.
16	- Dadi's home (in Gulmohar Mohalla): a kacha mud house with a tiled roof, BROWN wooden door, swept aangan, green fields behind, exactly like the channel banner (`channel_assets/_work/banner_art.png`). There is no green door.
17	- Setting: Dadi's home, the Golu–Mitthu opening/closing frame and all Dadi Jasoos cases are in Gulmohar Mohalla. The story Dadi narrates inside a moral-story video can be set in any village or town the approved script names (e.g. Rampur in LONG_01); check location consistency against that script. Village kitchens still use a mitti ka chulha, never a gas stove.
18	- The action in each image must match what the line says at that moment (who is holding what, who is talking).
19	
20	## 3. Audio
21	- Final loudness: -14 LUFS integrated (±1), true peak ≤ -1.0 dBFS.
22	- Music sits under the voice: 12–14 dB below for Shorts, up to ~18–20 dB for narration-heavy long videos. If it is quieter than 20 dB under, flag it.
23	- Music level is measured one way only: integrated LUFS of the voice-only stem vs the music-only stem over the same speech sections. Builder and Munshi both use this method.
24	- Mood changes get a crossfade (≥1 s). No sudden music cuts under dialogue.
25	- No leaked background audio, clicks, or a line cut off mid-word.
26	
27	## 4. Captions
28	- One `.srt` per video, Hindi, UTF-8.
29	- Each caption must appear while that line is being spoken (±0.3 s), over the right character's shot.
30	- Lines whose timing was estimated rather than taken from Whisper must be listed in the report.
31	
32	## 5. Video
33	- Long video: 1920×1080, 30 fps, H.264, 16:9. Short: 1080×1920, ≤60 s, 9:16.
34	- Target length is set in the script. Allowed: ±10%, or inside the user's stated range. Anything beyond that is ASK.
35	- Preview builds (960×540) are only for review. They are never uploaded.
36	
37	## 6. Thumbnail
38	- 1280×720, JPG or PNG, ≤ 2 MB.
39	- Hindi text is rendered by libass/FFmpeg (HarfBuzz shaping), never drawn by the AI. Zoom in and check matras and joined letters (ड़, दु, क्ष, etc.).
40	- Text readable on a phone: letter height ≥ ~12% of frame height, high contrast, max ~4 words.
41	- Thumbnail text must not repeat the title word for word.
42	- No spoilers: no ending, no twist, no mystery answer.
43	- Bottom-right corner (~15% × 12%) has nothing important, because YouTube puts the duration there.
44	
45	## 7. Metadata
46	- Title ≤ 100 characters, no `<` or `>`. Description ≤ 5000 characters.
47	- Tags total ≤ 500 characters. 3–5 hashtags in the description (the first 3 show above the title; more than 15 and YouTube ignores all of them).
48	- Every CC BY music track used (e.g. Incompetech / Kevin MacLeod) is credited in the description exactly as its licence asks.
49	- Mystery (Dadi Jasoos) videos: the answer never goes in the title, description or thumbnail. It goes in the pinned comment 24 h after publishing.
50	- Made-for-kids and AI-disclosure values come from `munshi/channel_config.json`. Never guess them.
51	
52	## 8. Publishing
53	- Default publish time: 7:00 PM IST.
54	- At least 2 days between two long videos on the same channel. Shorts can go on other days.
55	- Nothing goes Public or gets scheduled without the user's OK in that conversation.
56	- One upload per video. If `output/upload_result.json` exists, do not upload again.
57	
58	## 9. Safety
59	- Never show or commit `.env`, `secrets/`, API keys or OAuth tokens.
60	- Never delete files; move them to `_to_delete/`.
```

```text
[
  {"scene": 1, "speaker": "golu", "mood": "comedy", "text": "ये पूरा डिब्बा मेरा है! किसी को नहीं दूँगा!"},
  {"scene": 1, "speaker": "mitthu", "shot": [0.66, 0.45, 1.5], "text": "मिठाई! मिठाई!"},
  {"scene": 2, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "अच्छा? तो पहले एक कहानी सुनो... एक लालची हलवाई की।"},

  {"scene": 3, "speaker": "dadi_story", "mood": "khushi", "pause_before": 0.6, "text": "बहुत पुरानी बात है। रामपुर गाँव के बाज़ार में घसीटा हलवाई की बड़ी-सी दुकान थी।"},
  {"scene": 4, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "उसकी जलेबियाँ दूर-दूर तक मशहूर थीं... पर उसका दिल बहुत छोटा था।"},
  {"scene": 5, "speaker": "woman", "text": "भैया, आधा किलो जलेबी देना।"},
  {"scene": 5, "speaker": "ghasita", "text": "पैसे पहले! और तराज़ू की तरफ़ मत देखना!"},
  {"scene": 6, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "घसीटा तराज़ू में डंडी मारता, और बासी मिठाई भी ताज़ी बताकर बेच देता।"},
  {"scene": 7, "speaker": "kid", "text": "चाचा, एक जलेबी... बस एक सिक्का कम है।"},
  {"scene": 7, "speaker": "ghasita", "text": "एक सिक्का भी कम, तो जलेबी नहीं! भागो यहाँ से!"},
  {"scene": 8, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "उसी दुकान में छोटू काम करता था। ग़रीब था, पर दिल का सोना।"},
  {"scene": 9, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "छोटू ने चुपके से अपनी जेब का सिक्का निकाला और बच्चे को जलेबी दे दी।"},
  {"scene": 9, "speaker": "kid", "text": "धन्यवाद, छोटू भैया!"},

  {"scene": 10, "speaker": "dadi_story", "mood": "dukh", "text": "एक दोपहर, कड़ी धूप में एक बूढ़े साधु बाबा दुकान पर आए।"},
  {"scene": 11, "speaker": "sadhu", "shot": [0.25, 0.4, 1.8], "text": "बेटा, दो दिन से भूखा हूँ... थोड़ा खाना मिलेगा?"},
  {"scene": 11, "speaker": "ghasita", "shot": [0.62, 0.38, 1.8], "text": "मुफ़्त में? ये धर्मशाला नहीं है! आगे बढ़ो!"},
  {"scene": 12, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "साधु बाबा चुपचाप नीम के पेड़ के नीचे जाकर बैठ गए।"},
  {"scene": 13, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "छोटू से रहा नहीं गया। उसने अपने हिस्से की दो रोटियाँ उठाईं..."},
  {"scene": 13, "speaker": "chhotu", "text": "बाबा, मेरे पास बस यही है। आप खा लीजिए।"},
  {"scene": 14, "pause": 3.0},

  {"scene": 15, "speaker": "dadi_story", "mood": "jaadu", "text": "रोटी खाकर साधु बाबा मुस्कुराए, और झोली से एक छोटी-सी पीतल की कड़ाही निकाली।", "sfx_after": "magic"},
  {"scene": 16, "speaker": "sadhu", "text": "ये जादुई कड़ाही है, बेटा। इसमें जो डालोगे, दुगना हो जाएगा।"},
  {"scene": 16, "speaker": "sadhu", "text": "पर याद रखना — ये सिर्फ़ भूखों के लिए है। लालच के लिए नहीं।"},
  {"scene": 17, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "उस शाम छोटू ने कड़ाही में एक मुट्ठी आटा डाला... और आटा दो मुट्ठी हो गया!", "sfx_after": "magic"},
  {"scene": 17, "speaker": "chhotu", "text": "अरे वाह! ये तो सच में जादू है!"},

  {"scene": 18, "speaker": "dadi_story", "mood": "khushi", "text": "अब छोटू रोज़ रोटियाँ बनाता, और गाँव के भूखे बच्चों को खिलाता।"},
  {"scene": 19, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "आटा दुगना होता जाता... और बच्चों की मुस्कानें भी।"},
  {"scene": 19, "speaker": "kids", "chorus": true, "text": "छोटू भैया ज़िंदाबाद!"},

  {"scene": 20, "speaker": "dadi_story", "mood": "tension", "text": "पर ये बात घसीटा की नज़रों से छुपी नहीं रही।"},
  {"scene": 20, "speaker": "ghasita", "text": "आटा? हुँह! उस कड़ाही में तो सोना होना चाहिए... मेरा सोना!"},
  {"scene": 21, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "उसी रात, जब छोटू सो रहा था, घसीटा दबे पाँव आया और कड़ाही चुरा ले गया।"},
  {"scene": 22, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "दुकान में दीया जलाकर उसने कड़ाही में एक सोने का सिक्का डाला..."},
  {"scene": 22, "speaker": "ghasita", "text": "चल, दुगना कर!"},
  {"scene": 23, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "पर सिक्का दुगना नहीं हुआ... वो मिट्टी बन गया!", "sfx_after": "tension"},
  {"scene": 24, "speaker": "ghasita", "text": "क्या? शायद कम डाला... ये लो, दस और!"},
  {"scene": 24, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "दस सिक्के डाले — दसों मिट्टी! पर घसीटा का लालच और भड़क गया।"},
  {"scene": 25, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "उसने पूरी तिजोरी उलट दी, फिर मिठाई के थाल, फिर चाँदी के बर्तन..."},
  {"scene": 25, "speaker": "ghasita", "text": "अब तो दुगना होगा! होना ही होगा!"},
  {"scene": 26, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "पर कड़ाही में जो भी गया, सब मिट्टी बनता गया। सुबह तक दुकान में मिट्टी के ढेर के सिवा कुछ नहीं बचा।"},

  {"scene": 27, "pause": 1.0, "mood": "seekh", "sfx": "magic"},
  {"scene": 27, "speaker": "sadhu", "text": "लालच से भरे हाथ में जादू नहीं टिकता।", "af": "aecho=0.8:0.6:120|240:0.35|0.2"},
  {"scene": 28, "speaker": "ghasita", "text": "मेरा सब कुछ... सब कुछ चला गया!"},
  {"scene": 28, "pause": 2.0},

  {"scene": 29, "speaker": "dadi_story", "mood": "khushi", "text": "उधर, गाँव वाले भूले नहीं थे कि छोटू ने कैसे उनके बच्चों को खिलाया था।"},
  {"scene": 30, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "सबने मिलकर उसके लिए बाज़ार में एक छोटी-सी जलेबी की दुकान खुलवा दी।"},
  {"scene": 31, "speaker": "villager", "text": "छोटू की जलेबी! इसमें ईमानदारी का स्वाद है!"},
  {"scene": 32, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "छोटू सही तौलता, ताज़ा बनाता, और हर शाम एक थाल भूखों के लिए अलग रखता।"},
  {"scene": 33, "speaker": "dadi_story", "text": "देखते ही देखते उसकी छोटी-सी दुकान पूरे गाँव की सबसे प्यारी दुकान बन गई।"},
  {"scene": 34, "speaker": "dadi_story", "mood": "seekh", "text": "और घसीटा? लालच ने उससे सब कुछ छीन लिया था।"},
  {"scene": 35, "speaker": "chhotu", "mood": "khushi", "text": "घसीटा चाचा, आइए... एक जलेबी आपके लिए भी।"},

  {"scene": 36, "speaker": "golu", "pause_before": 0.6, "text": "दादी... अगर मैं सब अकेले खाऊँगा, तो मैं भी घसीटा बन जाऊँगा!"},
  {"scene": 36, "speaker": "golu", "text": "ये लो, एक लड्डू आपका... और एक मिठ्ठू का!"},
  {"scene": 37, "speaker": "mitthu", "text": "लालच! लालच! ना-ना-ना!", "sfx_after": "comedy"},
  {"scene": 38, "speaker": "dadi_story", "pause_before": 0.4, "text": "शाबाश बेटा! याद रखना — लालच का अंत हमेशा बुरा होता है, और बाँटने से ख़ुशी दुगनी होती है।"}
]

लालची हलवाई और जादुई कड़ाही | दादी की कहानियाँ | Hindi Moral Story | Hindi Kahani

DESCRIPTION:
रामपुर गाँव का घसीटा हलवाई बहुत लालची था — तराज़ू में डंडी मारता और भूखे को भी भगा देता। पर उसका नौकर छोटू दिल का सोना था। एक दिन एक भूखे साधु बाबा ने छोटू को दी एक जादुई कड़ाही... जो डालो, दुगना! पर जब घसीटा ने लालच में उसे चुराया, तो क्या हुआ? 🍯✨

सीख: लालच का अंत हमेशा बुरा होता है — और बाँटने से ख़ुशी दुगनी होती है।

दादी की कहानियाँ — दादी हर हफ़्ते सुनाती हैं एक नई कहानी, जो हँसाए भी और सिखाए भी।
```

```text
198	    cache = audio_dir / "tts_cache"

203	            start, t = t + gap, t + gap + line["pause"]

242	def ass_time(s):
243	    cs = max(0, int(round(s * 100)))
244	    return f"{cs // 360000}:{cs // 6000 % 60:02d}:{cs // 100 % 60:02d}.{cs % 100:02d}"

247	def caption_chunks(line):
248	    """[(start, end, text)] in global seconds, 2-3 words each, never past the line's audio.
249	    An optional "caption" in lines.json changes only the on-screen text (no new TTS); its words are timed
250	    through character position on the spoken words' timeline."""
251	    words = line["words"]
252	    tokens = line.get("caption", line["text"]).split()
253	    if "caption" in line and len(tokens) != len(words):
254	        lens = [_clean_len(w) + 1 for _, _, w in words]
255	        xs = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(lens)]) / sum(lens)
256	        ts = [words[0][0]] + [e for _, e, _ in words]
257	        clens = [_clean_len(t) + 1 for t in tokens]
258	        cx = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(clens)]) / sum(clens)
259	        words = [(float(np.interp(cx[k], xs, ts)), float(np.interp(cx[k + 1], xs, ts)), tok)
260	                 for k, tok in enumerate(tokens)]
261	    chunks, cur, punct = [], [], r"[।!?,.…]$"
262	    for j, (tok, (s, e, _)) in enumerate(zip(tokens, words)):
263	        cur.append((tok, s, e))
264	        nxt = tokens[j + 1] if j + 1 < len(tokens) else None
265	        lone_next = nxt is not None and re.search(punct, nxt) and len(cur) < 4  # don't orphan "है!"
266	        if (len(cur) >= 3 and not lone_next) or re.search(punct, tok):
267	            chunks.append(cur)
268	            cur = []
269	    if cur:
270	        chunks.append(cur)
271	    dur = lambda k: (chunks[k + 1][0][1] if k + 1 < len(chunks) else line["end"]) - chunks[k][0][1]
272	    k = 0
273	    while len(chunks) > 1 and k < len(chunks):
274	        if dur(k) < MIN_CAPTION:  # merge into the previous chunk (or the next one, for the first)
275	            j = k - 1 if k else 0
276	            chunks[j:j + 2] = [chunks[j] + chunks[j + 1]]
277	            k = 0
278	        else:
279	            k += 1
280	    out = []
281	    for k, ch in enumerate(chunks):
282	        end = chunks[k + 1][0][1] if k + 1 < len(chunks) else line["end"]
283	        out.append((ch[0][1], end, " ".join(tok for tok, _, _ in ch)))
284	    return out

305	# ---------- 3. video: one cached clip per scene ----------
306	def shot_times(timed, total):
307	    """Per scene: cut points (seconds). A scene starts CUT_LEAD before its first line's voice; inside a scene
308	    every new speaker's line also starts a shot CUT_LEAD early; long stretches are split every ~SHOT_LEN.
309	    A line with "shot" in lines.json ("wide" or [x, y, zoom]) gets that one shot for its whole stretch.
310	    Returns (scene, cut points, per-shot override or None)."""
311	    scenes = []
312	    for i, line in enumerate(timed):
313	        t = 0.0 if i == 0 else line["start"] - CUT_LEAD
314	        if not scenes or scenes[-1][0] != line["scene"]:
315	            scenes.append([line["scene"], [t], [i]])
316	        elif line["speaker"] != timed[i - 1]["speaker"]:
317	            scenes[-1][1].append(t)
318	            scenes[-1][2].append(i)
319	    out = []
320	    for k, (sc, cuts, owners) in enumerate(scenes):
321	        end = scenes[k + 1][1][0] if k + 1 < len(scenes) else total
322	        pts = cuts + [end]
323	        fine, tags = [pts[0]], []
324	        for a, b, own in zip(pts, pts[1:], owners):
325	            if timed[own].get("shot"):
326	                fine.append(b)
327	                tags.append(timed[own]["shot"])
328	                continue
329	            n = max(1, min(round((b - a) / SHOT_LEN), int((b - a) / MIN_SHOT)))
330	            fine += [a + (b - a) * j / n for j in range(1, n + 1)]
331	            tags += [None] * n
332	        if len(fine) == 2 and tags[0] is None and fine[1] - fine[0] >= 2 * MIN_SHOT:  # at least wide + close
333	            fine.insert(1, (fine[0] + fine[1]) / 2)
334	            tags.append(None)
335	        out.append((sc, fine, tags))
336	    return out

339	def plan_scenes(P, timed, total, prof, font_family, final_title):
340	    """Everything needed to render each scene clip, plus its cache hash."""
341	    focus = P["focus"]
342	    fps, plans = prof["fps"], []
343	    shots_all = shot_times(timed, total)
344	    for idx, (sc, cuts, tags) in enumerate(shots_all):
345	        fcuts = [round(c * fps) for c in cuts]  # one global frame grid -> no drift between clips
346	        t0 = fcuts[0] / fps
347	        spec = focus.get(str(sc), [])
348	        closes, wide = (spec["closes"], spec.get("wide", True)) if isinstance(spec, dict) else (spec, True)
349	        # 1 shot: close-up matters more; "wide": false (scene sharing an image with another) -> close-ups only
350	        cycle = closes if (closes and (len(cuts) == 2 or not wide)) else ["wide"] + closes
351	        shots, desc = [], []
352	        for k in range(len(cuts) - 1):
353	            n = fcuts[k + 1] - fcuts[k]
354	            shot = tags[k] or cycle[k % len(cycle)]

451	def track_levels(f: Path):
452	    """Music track loudness every 0.1 s (dB, 0.5 s RMS window), for picking where to start a track."""
453	    if f not in _levels:
454	        r = subprocess.run([str(FFMPEG), "-v", "error", "-i", str(f), "-ac", "1", "-ar", "8000", "-f", "s16le", "-"],
455	                           capture_output=True)
456	        x = np.frombuffer(r.stdout, np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768
457	        e = np.convolve(x ** 2, np.ones(4000) / 4000, mode="same")[::800]
458	        _levels[f] = 10 * np.log10(e + 1e-12)
459	    return _levels[f]

462	def music_offset(f: Path, a, b, windows):
463	    """Seconds into the track to start a segment [a, b] so no music-only pause (plus PAUSE_LEAD before it) lands
464	    in a near-silent gap of the track (e.g. between piano phrases). 0 when the segment has no pause."""
465	    wins = [(max(s, a), min(e, b)) for s, e in windows if e > a and s < b]
466	    if not wins:
467	        return 0.0
468	    lev = track_levels(f)
469	    n = len(lev)
470	    idx = [i for s, e in wins if len(i := np.arange(int((s - a) * 10), int((e - a) * 10)))]
471	    if not idx:
472	        return 0.0
473	    score = lambda off: min(lev[(i + int(off * 10)) % n].min() for i in idx)
474	    ok = np.median(lev) - 10  # within 10 dB of the track's usual level counts as audible
475	    if score(0) >= ok:
476	        return 0.0
477	    return float(max(np.arange(0, 20.01, 0.25), key=lambda off: (min(score(off), ok), -off)))

522	    ln = f"loudnorm=I={TARGET_LUFS}:TP=-1.5:LRA=11"

545	        return float(re.findall(r"I:\s+(-?[\d.]+) LUFS", r.stderr)[-1])

547	    below = speech_lufs(work / "voice.wav") - speech_lufs(work / "music.wav")
```

```text
SHOT_LEN = 2.6  # target seconds per shot -> visual changes every 2-3s
MIN_SHOT = 1.2  # never cut faster than this
CUT_LEAD = 0.1  # a speaker's shot starts this long before their voice, never earlier
TARGET_LUFS = -14

    "pan": ("1.08", "(iw-iw/zoom)*on/{n}", "ih/2-ih/zoom/2"),

def trim(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Trim lead/tail silence by energy so the line's voice starts at its first sample."""
    x = np.frombuffer(data, np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768
    hop = int(0.01 * SR)
    lev = 20 * np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(x[: len(x) // hop * hop].reshape(-1, hop) ** 2, axis=1)) + 1e-9)
    voiced = np.where(lev > lev.max() - 35)[0]
    s0 = max(0, voiced[0] * hop - int(0.01 * SR))
    e0 = min(len(x), (voiced[-1] + 1) * hop + int(TAIL * SR))
    return data[s0 * 2:e0 * 2]


_whisper = None
```

```text
def tts_key(text, speaker):
    voice, style, _ = CAST[speaker]
    return f"{speaker}_{sha(gemini_tts.MODEL, '|', voice, '|', style, '|', text)}.wav"


def check_tts_spend(lines, cache: Path, allow: bool):
    """Paid TTS only on cache miss, and only with --spend. Otherwise stop and show the estimate."""
    misses = [l for l in lines if "text" in l and not (cache / tts_key(l["text"], l["speaker"])).exists()]
    if not misses:
        return
    secs = sum(len(l["text"].split()) / 2.4 for l in misses)  # ~2.4 words/s
    usd = secs * gemini_tts.AUDIO_TOKENS_PER_SEC * gemini_tts.PRICE_OUT / 1e6
    print(f"  {len(misses)} TTS line(s) not cached: " + ", ".join(l["speaker"] for l in misses)
          + f"  -> ~₹{usd * cost_log.USD_TO_INR:.2f}")
    if not allow:
        sys.exit("  Paid TTS needed. Re-run with --spend to allow it.")


def tts_line(text, speaker, cache: Path, out: Path, extra_af=None, chorus=False) -> bytes:
    """Cached Gemini TTS + optional pitch shift / extra filter (e.g. echo) / chorus (3 detuned, offset copies
    so one voice sounds like a group). Returns PCM s16 mono."""
    raw = cache / tts_key(text, speaker)
    if not raw.exists():
        voice, style, _ = CAST[speaker]
        res = gemini_tts.speak(text, voice, style, raw)
        print(f"    new TTS {speaker}: ₹{res['row']['cost_inr']} (aaj ₹{res['row']['today_total_inr']}, "
              f"bacha ₹{res['row']['remaining_inr']})")
    chain = ",".join(f for f in (pitch_filter(CAST[speaker][2], SR), extra_af) if f) or "anull"
    if chorus:
        fc = (f"[0:a]{chain},asplit=3[a][b][c];[b]{pitch_filter(2, SR)},adelay=45[b2];"
              f"[c]{pitch_filter(-2, SR)},adelay=90[c2];[a][b2][c2]amix=inputs=3:normalize=0,volume=0.6[o]")
        args = ["-filter_complex", fc, "-map", "[o]"]
    else:
        args = ["-af", chain]
    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-i", raw, *args, "-ac", "1", "-ar", SR, "-sample_fmt", "s16", out])
    with wave.open(str(out)) as w:
        return w.readframes(w.getnframes())
```

```bash
mkdir -p /d/Story-Channel/long-videos/long_01/output/review/rr2; cat > /d/Story-Channel/long-videos/long_01/output/review/rr2/timings.py <<'EOF'
import json, wave, numpy as np, sys
P="D:/Story-Channel/long-videos/long_01/"
SR=24000; GAP=0.30; END_HOLD=1.5; TAIL=0.12
lines=json.load(open(P+"lines.json",encoding="utf-8"))
def trim(x):
    hop=int(0.01*SR)
    lev=20*np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(x[:len(x)//hop*hop].reshape(-1,hop)**2,axis=1))+1e-9)
    v=np.where(lev>lev.max()-35)[0]
    s0=max(0,v[0]*hop-int(0.01*SR)); e0=min(len(x),(v[-1]+1)*hop+int(TAIL*SR))
    return x[s0:e0]
t=0.0; out=[]; pcm=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if "pause" in l:
        gap=GAP if i else 0
        s=t+gap; t=s+l["pause"]; pcm.append(np.zeros(int(round((gap+l["pause"])*SR))))
        out.append(dict(n=i+1,sp="_pause",scene=l["scene"],start=s,end=t)); continue
    w=wave.open(P+f"audio/line_{i+1:02d}_{l['speaker']}.wav"); x=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768
    d=trim(x)
    if i:
        gap=GAP+l.get("pause_before",0); pcm.append(np.zeros(int(round(gap*SR)))); t+=gap
    s=t; pcm.append(d); t+=len(d)/SR
    out.append(dict(n=i+1,sp=l["speaker"],scene=l["scene"],start=s,end=t))
tot=t+END_HOLD
pcm.append(np.zeros(int(round(END_HOLD*SR))))
rec=np.concatenate(pcm)
w=wave.open(P+"output/long_01_work/voice.wav"); vw=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768
print("total",tot,"rec samples",len(rec),"voice.wav samples",len(vw), "sr",w.getframerate())
m=min(len(rec),len(vw)); print("max abs diff", np.abs(rec[:m]-vw[:m]).max())
json.dump(out,open(P+"output/review/rr2/timed.json","w"),indent=0)
for o in out: print(f"{o['n']:2d} sc{o['scene']:2d} {o['sp']:10s} {o['start']:7.2f}-{o['end']:7.2f}")
EOF
cd /d/Story-Channel && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -X utf8 long-videos/long_01/output/review/rr2/timings.py
```

Read word_times and check SRT encoding

`cd /d/Story-Channel; sed -n 143,192p scripts/make_short.py; file long-videos/long_01/output/long_01.srt; head -c 3 long-videos/long_01/output/long_01.srt | xxd | head -1`

```text
def _clean_len(s):
    return len(re.sub(r"[^\u0900-\u097F\w]", "", s))


def word_times(data: bytes, text: str, cache: Path, run_whisper: bool):
    """Script tokens timed by Whisper word timestamps (cached per audio). Whisper's spelling may differ from the
    script, so timings are mapped through character position. Without a cached result, Whisper only runs when
    run_whisper (final); otherwise timings are proportional to word length."""
    global _whisper
    tokens = text.split()
    dur = len(data) / 2 / SR
    key = cache / f"words_{sha(data)}.json"
    ww, note = [], None
    if key.exists():
        ww = json.loads(key.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    elif run_whisper:
        if _whisper is None:
            from faster_whisper import WhisperModel
            _whisper = WhisperModel("small", device="cpu", compute_type="int8",
                                    download_root=str(ROOT / "tools" / "whisper-models"))
        x = np.frombuffer(data, np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768
        x16 = np.interp(np.arange(0, len(x), SR / 16000), np.arange(len(x)), x).astype(np.float32)
        # no initial_prompt: with the script as prompt Whisper sometimes skips words it thinks were already said
        segs, _ = _whisper.transcribe(x16, language="hi", word_timestamps=True, beam_size=5)
        ww = [(w.start, w.end, w.word.strip()) for s in segs for w in (s.words or []) if _clean_len(w.word)]
        key.write_text(json.dumps(ww, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        note = "proportional (Whisper runs on --final)"
    # only trust Whisper if it heard roughly the whole line (it can drop words)
    coverage = sum(_clean_len(w) for _, _, w in ww) / max(1, sum(_clean_len(t) for t in tokens))
    if ww and not 0.75 <= coverage <= 1.35:
        ww, note = [], f"PROPORTIONAL (whisper coverage {coverage:.0%})"
    if ww:
        lens = [_clean_len(w) for _, _, w in ww]
        tot, acc, xs, ts = sum(lens), 0, [], []
        for (a, b, _), n in zip(ww, lens):
            xs += [acc / tot, (acc + n) / tot]
            ts += [a, b]
            acc += n
        xs[0], xs[-1] = 0.0, 1.0
        note = f"whisper {coverage:.0%}"
    else:
        xs, ts = [0.0, 1.0], [0.0, dur]
    lens = [_clean_len(t) + 1 for t in tokens]
    tot, acc, words = sum(lens), 0, []
    for tok, n in zip(tokens, lens):
        words.append((float(np.interp(acc / tot, xs, ts)), float(np.interp((acc + n) / tot, xs, ts)), tok))
        acc += n
    return words, note
```

```text
def sha(*parts) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha1()
    for p in parts:
        h.update(p if isinstance(p, bytes) else str(p).encode("utf-8"))
    return h.hexdigest()[:16]
```

```bash
cat > /d/Story-Channel/long-videos/long_01/output/review/rr2/caps.py <<'EOF'
import json, wave, numpy as np, re, hashlib
P="D:/Story-Channel/long-videos/long_01/"; SR=24000
lines=json.load(open(P+"lines.json",encoding="utf-8")); t=json.load(open(P+"output/review/rr2/timed.json"))
cl=lambda s:len(re.sub(r"[^\u0900-\u097F\w]","",s))
def trim(b):
    x=np.frombuffer(b,np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768; hop=240
    lev=20*np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(x[:len(x)//hop*hop].reshape(-1,hop)**2,axis=1))+1e-9)
    v=np.where(lev>lev.max()-35)[0]; s0=max(0,v[0]*hop-240); e0=min(len(x),(v[-1]+1)*hop+int(0.12*SR)); return b[s0*2:e0*2]
print("-- whisper status")
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if "pause" in l: continue
    w=wave.open(P+f"audio/line_{i+1:02d}_{l['speaker']}.wav"); d=trim(w.readframes(w.getnframes()))
    k=P+"audio/tts_cache/words_"+hashlib.sha1(d).hexdigest()[:16]+".json"
    try: ww=json.load(open(k,encoding="utf-8")); cov=sum(cl(x[2]) for x in ww)/max(1,sum(cl(x) for x in l["text"].split()))
    except FileNotFoundError: ww=None; cov=None
    st="NO CACHE" if ww is None else ("whisper %.0f%%"%(cov*100) if ww and 0.75<=cov<=1.35 else "PROPORTIONAL cov %s"%cov)
    if st.startswith("whisper")==False or True:
        if not st.startswith("whisper"): print(" line",i+1,l["speaker"],st)
print("-- srt")
s=open(P+"output/long_01.srt",encoding="utf-8").read().replace("\r","")
cues=[]
for blk in s.strip().split("\n\n"):
    ls=blk.split("\n"); a,b=ls[1].split(" --> ")
    f=lambda x:int(x[:2])*3600+int(x[3:5])*60+int(x[6:8])+int(x[9:])/1000
    cues.append((int(ls[0]),f(a),f(b)," ".join(ls[2:])))
print("cues",len(cues),"min dur %.3f"%min(c[2]-c[1] for c in cues))
short=[c for c in cues if c[2]-c[1]<0.45]; print("cues <0.45s:",short)
sp=[o for o in t if o["sp"]!="_pause"]
bad=[]; joined={}
for c in cues:
    own=[o for o in sp if c[1]>=o["start"]-0.3 and c[2]<=o["end"]+0.3]
    if not own: bad.append(c)
    else: joined.setdefault(own[0]["n"],[]).append(c[3])
print("cues outside any line ±0.3:",bad)
for o in sp:
    txt=" ".join(joined.get(o["n"],[])); ref=lines[o["n"]-1]["text"]
    if txt.split()!=ref.split(): print("TEXT MISMATCH line",o["n"],"|",txt,"|",ref)
ov=[(a,b) for a,b in zip(cues,cues[1:]) if b[1]<a[2]-1e-3]; print("overlaps",ov)
print("first/last", cues[0][:3], cues[-1][:3])
EOF
cd /d/Story-Channel && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -X utf8 long-videos/long_01/output/review/rr2/caps.py
```

```text
# Munshi RULES — Story-Channel

These are the hard rules. If a builder summary, a script or a file disagrees with them, the rule wins and the step is not PASS. Edit this file to add new rules; Munshi reads it fresh every time.
- A measured value outside a RULES limit is always FIX, never PASS, even if small.

## 1. Budget
- Prepaid Google Cloud budget: ₹500, auto-reload off. Current balance is whatever `cost_log.csv` says.
- Every paid call (Gemini image ≈ ₹3.24 each at 1K, Gemini TTS per line) must be in `cost_log.csv` with date, project, item, ₹.
- No paid call without the user's OK first. A fix that costs money is always ASK, never FIX.
- Flag it if a step cost more than 30% above its estimate (e.g. LONG_01 TTS: estimate ₹4.85, actual ₹6.63).

## 2. Story and characters (from `channel_bible.md`)
- Characters must match their approved sheets: face, clothes, colours, age look. Compare each scene image against the sheet with Read.
- Dadi (Kamla Devi) narrates. Every other character speaks their own lines in their own voice.
- Mitthu (parrot) has no hands: no hand gestures, holding things or pointing with hands.
- Dadi's home (in Gulmohar Mohalla): a kacha mud house with a tiled roof, BROWN wooden door, swept aangan, green fields behind, exactly like the channel banner (`channel_assets/_work/banner_art.png`). There is no green door.
- Setting: Dadi's home, the Golu–Mitthu opening/closing frame and all Dadi Jasoos cases are in Gulmohar Mohalla. The story Dadi narrates inside a moral-story video can be set in any village or town the approved script names (e.g. Rampur in LONG_01); check location consistency against that script. Village kitchens still use a mitti ka chulha, never a gas stove.
- The action in each image must match what the line says at that moment (who is holding what, who is talking).

## 3. Audio
- Final loudness: -14 LUFS integrated (±1), true peak ≤ -1.0 dBFS.
- Music sits under the voice: 12–14 dB below for Shorts, up to ~18–20 dB for narration-heavy long videos. If it is quieter than 20 dB under, flag it.
- Music level is measured one way only: integrated LUFS of the voice-only stem vs the music-only stem over the same speech sections. Builder and Munshi both use this method.
- Mood changes get a crossfade (≥1 s). No sudden music cuts under dialogue.
- No leaked background audio, clicks, or a line cut off mid-word.

## 4. Captions
- One `.srt` per video, Hindi, UTF-8.
- Each caption must appear while that line is being spoken (±0.3 s), over the right character's shot.
- Lines whose timing was estimated rather than taken from Whisper must be listed in the report.

## 5. Video
- Long video: 1920×1080, 30 fps, H.264, 16:9. Short: 1080×1920, ≤60 s, 9:16.
- Target length: the duration the user approved at preview. Before preview, the script estimate is only a guide. Final must be within ±10% of the approved preview length; outside that is ASK.
- Preview builds (960×540) are only for review. They are never uploaded.

## 6. Thumbnail
- 1280×720, JPG or PNG, ≤ 2 MB.
- Hindi text is rendered by libass/FFmpeg (HarfBuzz shaping), never drawn by the AI. Zoom in and check matras and joined letters (ड़, दु, क्ष, etc.).
- Text readable on a phone: letter height ≥ ~12% of frame height, high contrast, max ~4 words.
- Thumbnail text must not repeat the title word for word.
- No spoilers: no ending, no twist, no mystery answer.
- Bottom-right corner (~15% × 12%) has nothing important, because YouTube puts the duration there.

## 7. Metadata
- Title ≤ 100 characters, no `<` or `>`. Description ≤ 5000 characters.
- Tags total ≤ 500 characters. 3–5 hashtags in the description (the first 3 show above the title; more than 15 and YouTube ignores all of them).
- Every CC BY music track used (e.g. Incompetech / Kevin MacLeod) is credited in the description exactly as its licence asks.
- Mystery (Dadi Jasoos) videos: the answer never goes in the title, description or thumbnail. It goes in the pinned comment 24 h after publishing.
- Made-for-kids and AI-disclosure values come from `munshi/channel_config.json`. Never guess them.

## 8. Publishing
- Default publish time: 7:00 PM IST.
- At least 2 days between two long videos on the same channel. Shorts can go on other days.
- Nothing goes Public or gets scheduled without the user's OK in that conversation.
- One upload per video. If `output/upload_result.json` exists, do not upload again.

## 9. Safety
- Never show or commit `.env`, `secrets/`, API keys or OAuth tokens.
- Never delete files; move them to `_to_delete/`.
```

```text
---
name: youtube-publish
description: Upload and schedule an approved Story-Channel video to YouTube with tools/youtube_upload.py, including one-time OAuth setup. Used by the munshi agent after the user approves the final build.
---

# Publish a video to YouTube

Uses `tools/youtube_upload.py` (YouTube Data API v3). Never upload without the user's explicit OK in this conversation.

## One-time setup (guide the user, they do the clicks in Google Cloud Console)
1. Use the same Google Cloud project as Gemini, or a new one. Enable **YouTube Data API v3**.
2. OAuth consent screen: User type External. Add the channel's Google account as a test user. Then **Publish app** (move it to In production). If it stays in Testing, the refresh token expires every 7 days and uploads stop working.
3. Credentials: Create OAuth client ID, type **Desktop app**. Download JSON and save it as `secrets/client_secret.json`. Make sure `secrets/` is in `.gitignore`.
4. `pip install google-api-python-client google-auth-oauthlib`
5. First real run opens a browser: pick the right Google account AND the right channel, accept the "unverified app" warning (it is the user's own app). Token is saved to `secrets/youtube_token_<channel_key>.json`; later runs are silent.
6. Phone-verify the channel in YouTube Studio, otherwise custom thumbnails fail.

## Important limit: unaudited API projects
Videos uploaded through the API from a project that has not passed YouTube's API audit are locked to **private**, and scheduling may not take effect. Until the audit is approved:
- Upload as private (the script does this when `publish_at` is set).
- Tell the user the one Studio step left: open the studio_url and set Schedule / Public.
- Suggest applying for the audit (YouTube API Services audit and quota extension form, free, takes a few weeks). After approval, scheduling becomes fully automatic.
Quota: default 10,000 units/day; one upload costs about 1,600, thumbnail 50, captions 400. Check the current numbers in the docs if uploads fail with quotaExceeded.

## Per-video steps
1. Confirm in `munshi/log.md`: PASS for final build, thumbnail and metadata of this project. Confirm `output/upload_result.json` does not exist.
2. Read `munshi/channel_config.json` for made_for_kids, contains_synthetic_media, category_id, language, publish time, playlist id. If made_for_kids is null, ASK the user and save the answer there.
3. Pick publish time: next free day at 19:00 IST respecting min_days_between_long (check other projects' upload_result.json).
4. Write `output/upload.json`:
   - channel_key, channel_name, channel_id (from `munshi/channel_config.json`)
   - format: "long" or "short"
   - title, description, tags (from the approved metadata file)
   - video: final mp4 (never *_preview*)
   - thumbnail, captions (.srt), language "hi", captions_name "Hindi"
   - made_for_kids, contains_synthetic_media, category_id
   - publish_at like 2026-10-21T19:00:00+05:30 (or privacy "private" with no publish_at)
   - playlist_id if configured
5. `python tools/youtube_upload.py --job <upload.json> --dry-run`. Fix any PROBLEMS.
   If the script says WRONG CHANNEL, stop and tell the user; never edit channel_id to make it pass.
6. Show the user: title, publish time IST, made-for-kids, playlist, thumbnail file. Wait for ha/ok.
7. Run without --dry-run. If thumbnail/captions/playlist failed, fix the cause and run with `--extras-only`.
8. Report: video URL, studio URL, what succeeded, and what still needs a click in Studio (schedule if locked private, pinned comment, end screen). Pinning a comment is not possible through the API.
9. Append a PUBLISHED line to `munshi/log.md`.

TITLE:
लालची हलवाई और जादुई कड़ाही | दादी की कहानियाँ | Hindi Moral Story | Hindi Kahani

DESCRIPTION:
रामपुर गाँव का घसीटा हलवाई बहुत लालची था — तराज़ू में डंडी मारता और भूखे को भी भगा देता। पर उसका नौकर छोटू दिल का सोना था। एक दिन एक भूखे साधु बाबा ने छोटू को दी एक जादुई कड़ाही... जो डालो, दुगना! पर जब घसीटा ने लालच में उसे चुराया, तो क्या हुआ? 🍯✨

सीख: लालच का अंत हमेशा बुरा होता है — और बाँटने से ख़ुशी दुगनी होती है।

दादी की कहानियाँ — दादी हर हफ़्ते सुनाती हैं एक नई कहानी, जो हँसाए भी और सिखाए भी।
```

```text
1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""YouTube uploader for Story-Channel, used by the Munshi agent.
3	
4	Usage:
5	    python tools/youtube_upload.py --job long-videos/long_01/output/upload.json --dry-run
6	    python tools/youtube_upload.py --job long-videos/long_01/output/upload.json
7	    python tools/youtube_upload.py --job ... --extras-only   # retry thumbnail/captions/playlist
8	
9	Safety: refuses to upload unless the logged-in channel ID matches job["channel_id"],
10	and unless ffprobe confirms the file is a real final build (size, codec, pix_fmt).
11	One token per channel: secrets/youtube_token_<channel_key>.json.
12	
13	One-time setup: see the youtube-publish skill. Needs
14	    pip install google-api-python-client google-auth-oauthlib
15	and secrets/client_secret.json (OAuth "Desktop app" client).
16	"""
17	import argparse
18	import datetime as dt
19	import json
20	import random
21	import sys
22	import time
23	from pathlib import Path
24	
25	try:
26	    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
27	    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
28	except Exception:
29	    pass
30	
31	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
32	SECRETS = ROOT / "secrets"
33	CLIENT_SECRET = SECRETS / "client_secret.json"
34	FORMATS = {  # what a final upload must look like
35	    "long": {"width": 1920, "height": 1080, "max_seconds": None},
36	    "short": {"width": 1080, "height": 1920, "max_seconds": 60},
37	}
38	SCOPES = [
39	    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload",
40	    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.force-ssl",  # captions + playlists
41	]
42	RETRY_STATUS = {500, 502, 503, 504}
43	MAX_RETRIES = 8
44	
45	
46	def resolve(job_path: Path, p):
47	    if not p:
48	        return None
49	    p = Path(p)
50	    return p if p.is_absolute() else (job_path.parent / p).resolve()
51	
52	
53	def token_path(job):
54	    return SECRETS / f"youtube_token_{job['channel_key']}.json"
55	
56	
57	def probe(video: Path):
58	    """Return (width, height, codec, pix_fmt, seconds) using ffprobe."""
59	    import shutil
60	    import subprocess
61	
62	    ffprobe = shutil.which("ffprobe")
63	    if not ffprobe:  # fallback: project's own FFmpeg build (bin/ layout, or flat tools/ffmpeg on this PC)
64	        ffprobe = next((str(p) for p in (ROOT / "tools" / "ffmpeg" / "bin" / "ffprobe.exe",
65	                                          ROOT / "tools" / "ffmpeg" / "ffprobe.exe") if p.exists()), None)
66	    if not ffprobe:
67	        raise RuntimeError("ffprobe not found (install FFmpeg)")
68	    out = subprocess.run(
69	        [ffprobe, "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0",
70	         "-show_entries", "stream=width,height,codec_name,pix_fmt",
71	         "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "json", str(video)],
72	        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
73	    d = json.loads(out)
74	    st = (d.get("streams") or [{}])[0]
75	    return (st.get("width"), st.get("height"), st.get("codec_name"),
76	            st.get("pix_fmt"), float(d.get("format", {}).get("duration", 0)))
77	
78	
79	def validate(job: dict, job_path: Path) -> list:
80	    errs = []
81	    key = job.get("channel_key", "")
82	    if not key or not all(c.isalnum() or c in "-_" for c in key):
83	        errs.append("channel_key missing/invalid (e.g. dadi-ki-kahaniyan)")
84	    cid = job.get("channel_id", "")
85	    if not (isinstance(cid, str) and cid.startswith("UC") and len(cid) == 24):
86	        errs.append("channel_id missing/invalid (24 chars, starts with UC; set it in munshi/channel_config.json)")
87	    fmt = job.get("format")
88	    if fmt not in FORMATS:
89	        errs.append("format must be 'long' or 'short'")
90	    title = job.get("title", "")
91	    desc = job.get("description", "")
92	    tags = job.get("tags", [])
93	    if not title:
94	        errs.append("title missing")
95	    if len(title) > 100:
96	        errs.append(f"title too long ({len(title)} > 100)")
97	    if len(desc) > 5000:
98	        errs.append(f"description too long ({len(desc)} > 5000)")
99	    for name, val in (("title", title), ("description", desc)):
100	        if "<" in val or ">" in val:
101	            errs.append(f"{name} contains < or >")
102	    if sum(len(t) for t in tags) + max(len(tags) - 1, 0) > 500:
103	        errs.append("tags exceed 500 characters")
104	    hashtags = [w for w in desc.split() if w.startswith("#")]
105	    if len(hashtags) > 15:
106	        errs.append(f"{len(hashtags)} hashtags in description (>15: YouTube ignores all)")
107	    if not isinstance(job.get("made_for_kids"), bool):
108	        errs.append("made_for_kids must be true/false (set it in munshi/channel_config.json)")
109	
110	    video = resolve(job_path, job.get("video"))
111	    if not video or not video.exists():
112	        errs.append(f"video not found: {video}")
113	    else:
114	        if "preview" in video.name.lower():
115	            errs.append("video looks like a preview build; upload final only")
116	        if fmt in FORMATS:
117	            try:
118	                w, h, codec, pix, secs = probe(video)
119	                want = FORMATS[fmt]
120	                if (w, h) != (want["width"], want["height"]):
121	                    errs.append(f"video is {w}x{h}, a final {fmt} must be {want['width']}x{want['height']}")
122	                if codec != "h264":
123	                    errs.append(f"video codec is {codec}, expected h264")
124	                if pix != "yuv420p":
125	                    errs.append(f"pixel format is {pix}, expected yuv420p")
126	                if secs < 5:
127	                    errs.append(f"video is only {secs:.1f}s long")
128	                if want["max_seconds"] and secs > want["max_seconds"]:
129	                    errs.append(f"short is {secs:.1f}s, max {want['max_seconds']}s")
130	                job["_probe"] = f"{w}x{h} {codec} {pix} {secs:.1f}s"
131	            except Exception as e:
132	                errs.append(f"ffprobe failed: {e}")
133	
134	    thumb = resolve(job_path, job.get("thumbnail"))
135	    if thumb:
136	        if not thumb.exists():
137	            errs.append(f"thumbnail not found: {thumb}")
138	        elif thumb.stat().st_size > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
139	            errs.append("thumbnail larger than 2 MB")
140	        elif thumb.suffix.lower() not in (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png"):
141	            errs.append("thumbnail must be .jpg or .png")
142	
143	    srt = resolve(job_path, job.get("captions"))
144	    if srt and not srt.exists():
145	        errs.append(f"captions not found: {srt}")
146	
147	    pub = job.get("publish_at")
148	    if pub:
149	        try:
150	            t = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(pub)
151	            if t.tzinfo is None:
152	                errs.append("publish_at needs a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-21T19:00:00+05:30")
153	            elif t <= dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) + dt.timedelta(minutes=15):
154	                errs.append("publish_at must be at least 15 minutes in the future")
155	        except ValueError:
156	            errs.append("publish_at is not ISO 8601")
157	    if job.get("privacy", "private") not in ("private", "unlisted", "public"):
158	        errs.append("privacy must be private, unlisted or public")
159	    return errs
160	
161	
162	def get_service(job):
163	    from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
164	    from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials
165	    from google_auth_oauthlib.flow import InstalledAppFlow
166	    from googleapiclient.discovery import build
167	
168	    tok = token_path(job)
169	    creds = None
170	    if tok.exists():
171	        creds = Credentials.from_authorized_user_file(str(tok), SCOPES)
172	    if not creds or not creds.valid:
173	        if creds and creds.expired and creds.refresh_token:
174	            creds.refresh(Request())
175	        else:
176	            if not CLIENT_SECRET.exists():
177	                sys.exit(f"Missing {CLIENT_SECRET}. Do the one-time setup first.")
178	            print(f"Browser login: pick the Google account AND the channel '{job.get('channel_name', job['channel_key'])}'.")
179	            flow = InstalledAppFlow.from_client_secrets_file(str(CLIENT_SECRET), SCOPES)
180	            creds = flow.run_local_server(port=0)
181	        SECRETS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
182	        tok.write_text(creds.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
183	    return build("youtube", "v3", credentials=creds)
184	
185	
186	def check_channel(yt, job):
187	    """Stop unless the logged-in channel is exactly the configured one."""
188	    items = yt.channels().list(part="id,snippet", mine=True).execute().get("items", [])
189	    if not items:
190	        sys.exit("Logged-in Google account has no YouTube channel. Nothing uploaded.")
191	    got = items[0]["id"]
192	    title = items[0]["snippet"]["title"]
193	    if got != job["channel_id"]:
194	        sys.exit(f"WRONG CHANNEL: logged in as '{title}' ({got}), expected {job['channel_id']}. "
195	                 f"Nothing uploaded. Delete {token_path(job).name} in secrets/ and log in again with the right channel.")
196	    print(f"Channel OK: {title} ({got})")
197	
198	
199	def with_retry(fn, label):
200	    from googleapiclient.errors import HttpError
201	
202	    for attempt in range(MAX_RETRIES + 1):
203	        try:
204	            return fn()
205	        except HttpError as e:
206	            if e.resp.status not in RETRY_STATUS or attempt == MAX_RETRIES:
207	                raise
208	        except (ConnectionError, OSError, TimeoutError):
209	            if attempt == MAX_RETRIES:
210	                raise
211	        wait = min(2 ** attempt + random.random(), 60)
212	        print(f"{label}: retry {attempt + 1} in {wait:.0f}s")
213	        time.sleep(wait)
214	
215	
216	def upload_video(yt, job, job_path):
217	    from googleapiclient.http import MediaFileUpload
218	
219	    status = {
220	        "privacyStatus": job.get("privacy", "private"),
221	        "selfDeclaredMadeForKids": job["made_for_kids"],
222	    }
223	    if "contains_synthetic_media" in job:
224	        status["containsSyntheticMedia"] = bool(job["contains_synthetic_media"])
225	    if job.get("publish_at"):
226	        status["privacyStatus"] = "private"  # required by YouTube for scheduling
227	        status["publishAt"] = job["publish_at"]
228	
229	    body = {
230	        "snippet": {
231	            "title": job["title"],
232	            "description": job.get("description", ""),
233	            "tags": job.get("tags", []),
234	            "categoryId": str(job.get("category_id", "1")),
235	            "defaultLanguage": job.get("language", "hi"),
236	            "defaultAudioLanguage": job.get("language", "hi"),
237	        },
238	        "status": status,
239	    }
240	    media = MediaFileUpload(str(resolve(job_path, job["video"])), mimetype="video/mp4",
241	                            chunksize=8 * 1024 * 1024, resumable=True)
242	    req = yt.videos().insert(part="snippet,status", body=body, media_body=media)
243	    response = None
244	    while response is None:
245	        st, response = with_retry(req.next_chunk, "upload")
246	        if st:
247	            print(f"upload {int(st.progress() * 100)}%")
248	    return response["id"]
249	
250	
251	def do_extras(yt, job, job_path, video_id, result):
252	    from googleapiclient.http import MediaFileUpload
253	
254	    thumb = resolve(job_path, job.get("thumbnail"))
255	    if thumb and not result.get("thumbnail_ok"):
256	        try:
257	            mt = "image/png" if thumb.suffix.lower() == ".png" else "image/jpeg"
258	            with_retry(lambda: yt.thumbnails().set(
259	                videoId=video_id, media_body=MediaFileUpload(str(thumb), mimetype=mt)).execute(),
260	                "thumbnail")
261	            result["thumbnail_ok"] = True
262	        except Exception as e:  # usually: channel not phone-verified
263	            result["thumbnail_error"] = str(e)[:300]
264	
265	    srt = resolve(job_path, job.get("captions"))
266	    if srt and not result.get("captions_ok"):
267	        try:
268	            lang = job.get("language", "hi")
269	            with_retry(lambda: yt.captions().insert(
270	                part="snippet",
271	                body={"snippet": {"videoId": video_id, "language": lang,
272	                                  "name": job.get("captions_name", "Hindi"), "isDraft": False}},
273	                media_body=MediaFileUpload(str(srt), mimetype="application/octet-stream"),
274	            ).execute(), "captions")
275	            result["captions_ok"] = True
276	        except Exception as e:
277	            result["captions_error"] = str(e)[:300]
278	
279	    pl = job.get("playlist_id")
280	    if pl and not result.get("playlist_ok"):
281	        try:
282	            with_retry(lambda: yt.playlistItems().insert(
283	                part="snippet",
284	                body={"snippet": {"playlistId": pl,
285	                                  "resourceId": {"kind": "youtube#video", "videoId": video_id}}},
286	            ).execute(), "playlist")
287	            result["playlist_ok"] = True
288	        except Exception as e:
289	            result["playlist_error"] = str(e)[:300]

292	def main():
293	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
```

## ⚠️ "Made for kids" par ek zaroori baat
Aapne pichhli baar Audience setting ke baare me poochha tha. Wahan aur `channel_config.json` dono me abhi "**No, not made for kids**" hai. Par ye channel bachchon ke liye cartoon moral stories bana raha hai, aur YouTube/COPPA ke niyam me animated characters aur bachchon wali kahaniyan aam taur par "made for kids" maani jaati hain. Galat setting par YouTube khud setting badal sakta hai ya channel par karvai kar sakta hai.

Ye kanooni faisla aapka hai. Mera sujhaav hai ki ek baar YouTube ki "What's content made for kids?" guide padh kar tay kijiye. Jo bhi chunenge, wahi `channel_config.json` me bhar dunga. Us settings page ke baaki options (ads, clips, AI training, dubbing) ka is project par koi asar nahi hai, wo aapki marzi.

## Step 9: YouTube API setup, Step 1
Ab ek-ek step karwata hoon. Har step ke baad aap "ho gaya" likhiye.

**Step 1: YouTube Data API v3 enable karna**
1. https://console.cloud.google.com kholiye. Usi Google account se login kijiye jisme Gemini ka project hai (ami.com wala nahi).
2. Upar-baayein project dropdown me wahi project chuniye jo Gemini ke liye use hota hai.
3. Upar search bar me **YouTube Data API v3** likhiye aur result par click kijiye.
4. Neeche **Enable** dabaiye. Agar "Manage" dikhe toh ye pehle se enable hai.

Ho jaye toh batana. Agla step OAuth consent screen ka hoga.

Yaad rahe: aage jab pehli baar browser me login hoga, tab **"दादी की कहानियाँ" channel hi chunna hai**. Ye main us waqt dobara yaad dilaunga.

```text
# Munshi RULES — Story-Channel

These are the hard rules. If a builder summary, a script or a file disagrees with them, the rule wins and the step is not PASS. Edit this file to add new rules; Munshi reads it fresh every time.
- A measured value outside a RULES limit is always FIX, never PASS, even if small.

## 1. Budget
- Prepaid Google Cloud budget: ₹500, auto-reload off. Current balance is whatever `cost_log.csv` says.
- Every paid call (Gemini image ≈ ₹3.24 each at 1K, Gemini TTS per line) must be in `cost_log.csv` with date, project, item, ₹.
- No paid call without the user's OK first. A fix that costs money is always ASK, never FIX.
- Flag it if a step cost more than 30% above its estimate (e.g. LONG_01 TTS: estimate ₹4.85, actual ₹6.63).

## 2. Story and characters (from `channel_bible.md`)
- Characters must match their approved sheets: face, clothes, colours, age look. Compare each scene image against the sheet with Read.
- Dadi (Kamla Devi) narrates. Every other character speaks their own lines in their own voice.
- Mitthu (parrot) has no hands: no hand gestures, holding things or pointing with hands.
- Dadi's home (in Gulmohar Mohalla): a kacha mud house with a tiled roof, BROWN wooden door, swept aangan, green fields behind, exactly like the channel banner (`channel_assets/_work/banner_art.png`). There is no green door.
- Setting: Dadi's home, the Golu–Mitthu opening/closing frame and all Dadi Jasoos cases are in Gulmohar Mohalla. The story Dadi narrates inside a moral-story video can be set in any village or town the approved script names (e.g. Rampur in LONG_01); check location consistency against that script. Village kitchens still use a mitti ka chulha, never a gas stove.
- The action in each image must match what the line says at that moment (who is holding what, who is talking).

## 3. Audio
- Final loudness: -14 LUFS integrated (±1), true peak ≤ -1.0 dBFS.
- Music sits under the voice: 12–14 dB below for Shorts, up to ~18–20 dB for narration-heavy long videos. If it is quieter than 20 dB under, flag it.
- Music level is measured one way only: integrated LUFS of the voice-only stem vs the music-only stem over the same speech sections. Builder and Munshi both use this method.
- Mood changes get a crossfade (≥1 s). No sudden music cuts under dialogue.
- No leaked background audio, clicks, or a line cut off mid-word.

## 4. Captions
- One `.srt` per video, Hindi, UTF-8.
- Each caption must appear while that line is being spoken (±0.3 s), over the right character's shot.
- Lines whose timing was estimated rather than taken from Whisper must be listed in the report.

## 5. Video
- Long video: 1920×1080, 30 fps, H.264, 16:9. Short: 1080×1920, ≤60 s, 9:16.
- Target length: the duration the user approved at preview. Before preview, the script estimate is only a guide. Final must be within ±10% of the approved preview length; outside that is ASK.
- Preview builds (960×540) are only for review. They are never uploaded.

## 6. Thumbnail
- 1280×720, JPG or PNG, ≤ 2 MB.
- Hindi text is rendered by libass/FFmpeg (HarfBuzz shaping), never drawn by the AI. Zoom in and check matras and joined letters (ड़, दु, क्ष, etc.).
- Text readable on a phone: letter height ≥ ~12% of frame height, high contrast, max ~4 words.
- Thumbnail text must not repeat the title word for word.
- No spoilers: no ending, no twist, no mystery answer.
- Bottom-right corner (~15% × 12%) has nothing important, because YouTube puts the duration there.

## 7. Metadata
- Title ≤ 100 characters, no `<` or `>`. Description ≤ 5000 characters.
- Tags total ≤ 500 characters. 3–5 hashtags in the description (the first 3 show above the title; more than 15 and YouTube ignores all of them).
- Every CC BY music track used (e.g. Incompetech / Kevin MacLeod) is credited in the description exactly as its licence asks.
- Mystery (Dadi Jasoos) videos: the answer never goes in the title, description or thumbnail. It goes in the pinned comment 24 h after publishing.
- Made-for-kids and AI-disclosure values come from `munshi/channel_config.json`. Never guess them.

## 8. Publishing
- Default publish time: 7:00 PM IST.
- At least 2 days between two long videos on the same channel. Shorts can go on other days.
- Nothing goes Public or gets scheduled without the user's OK in that conversation.
- One upload per video. If `output/upload_result.json` exists, do not upload again.

## 9. Safety
- Never show or commit `.env`, `secrets/`, API keys or OAuth tokens.
- Never delete files; move them to `_to_delete/`.

## 10. Copyright (STRICT — any violation is FIX and blocks upload)
- Every external file used in any video (music, sound effect, font, image, footage, voice) must have a row in `munshi/assets_license.csv`: path, source_url, author, license, attribution_text, date_added. No row = not allowed.
- Allowed licences only: CC0; CC BY 4.0 (with exact credit in the description); SIL OFL (fonts); YouTube Audio Library tracks (follow their attribution note); our own Gemini-generated images/voices; our own recordings.
- Never allowed: CC BY-NC (non-commercial, conflicts with monetization), CC BY-ND (we edit/mix), CC BY-SA, "free for personal use", Freesound "Sampling+", unknown source, anything ripped from YouTube/Spotify/Instagram/films/TV, Bollywood or any commercial song (even hummed or sung by TTS), Google/Pinterest images.
- Freesound: licence is per sound. Check each file's own licence page; only CC0 or CC BY 4.0.
- Content: no real brand logos, no film/TV/cartoon characters (Chhota Bheem, Motu Patlu, Disney, etc.), no celebrity likeness, no copied song lyrics, no copied text from modern books. Old folk tales (Panchatantra, Jataka, Akbar-Birbal) are public domain, but we always write our own version, never copy a modern retelling.
- Image prompts never name a studio, franchise or living artist ("Pixar style", "Ghibli style", etc.).
- Before upload, Munshi checks: every audio/image/font file in the final build is in the register, every CC BY item is credited in the description exactly as its licence asks, and no source audio from outside our pipeline is in the mix.
- After upload: if YouTube Studio shows any copyright claim or strike, stop all new uploads and tell the user. CC music sometimes gets false Content ID claims; dispute only with the licence proof from the register, after the user agrees.
```
